assessment_scope: Manual dietary intake estimates; not clinical nutritional status or diagnosis.
scope: Fictional crew demonstration. Names are labels; ages, reference-table sex, intake and blood values are invented, not these people's health records.

provenance.identity: Names supplied by the user for fictional presentation profiles. Age and sex are explicit sample assumptions, not inferred from the names.
provenance.targets: Illustrative manual planning targets; not reviewed, personalized prescriptions or medically derived targets.
provenance.food_logs: Seven declared-complete example ingredient logs (mission days 1–7), generated deterministically; not observed meals or a recommended complete diet.
provenance.blood_samples: Invented measurements on mission days 1, 15 and 30, unrelated to food-log calculations. No laboratory, camera or physiological measurements were taken.
limitations: Only energy, protein and vitamin C dietary intake are calculated; iron intake and blood iron are not modeled.
Ferritin is a marker used to assess iron stores; it is not a blood iron concentration or a nutrient target.
Dry oats and raw lentils use dry ingredient mass; cooking, absorption and nutrient retention are not modeled.
Low reference comparisons illustrate a fictional scenario, not automatic diagnosis or treatment. No treatment response is assumed.
Intake coverage and laboratory values use distinct units and cannot be plotted as one combined health score.
Added Sample Crew profiles have no blood measurements; missing laboratory data stays unknown.

hemoglobin.scope: WHO 2024 adult ages 15–65 nonpregnant female/male lower anaemia cutoffs; illustration assumes sea level and no smoking; not normal ranges or treatment targets.

ferritin.scope: WHO 2020 apparently healthy adult without infection/inflammation cutoff; inflammation and pregnancy require context.
